title: Combined Cumulative AI Model Releases
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Capability Tracking
description: Line chart of the compounding total of major AI model releases across 11 labs, month by month since November 2022.

learningObjectives: Interpret a cumulative (running total) line chart
Contrast a rate chart with a cumulative chart of the same underlying data

keyQuestions: How does the cumulative curve's steepness change over time?
Why does a cumulative view make growth look more dramatic than a per-year bar chart?
commonMisconceptions: Mistaking a steep cumulative curve for a steep per-period rate, when the rate could be flat or even declining
assessmentOpportunities: Ask learners to extrapolate the end-of-2026 cumulative total from the current slope

dataSource.name: AI Release Tracker
dataSource.note: Chart values live in ../ai-release-data/data.json, shared with five other MicroSims.
